title: Functional Projection and Complexity Reduction
summary: Törnquist (arXiv:1310.3250) proved that if there exists a $\boldsymbolΣ^1_2$ maximal almost disjoint (MAD) family, then there exists a $\boldsymbolΠ^1_1$ MAD family. Since then, several other "complexity reduction" proofs have been found for other combinatorial objects, such as maximal independent families or ultrafilters. All of these proofs have relied on $\boldsymbolΠ^1_1$-uniformization, so they did not easily lift to higher projective levels.
